visual_cards.visual_notes: Official page exposes a coherent WAM architecture, full result panels, and diverse single-arm, bimanual and dexterous-hand executions.
Official open-world, real-robot, GUMI, Franka and AgileX examples visibly support the cross-task/interface claims.
failure_modes: Small discrete steps can make execution slow; result breadth still limited.

visual_cards.visual_notes: Acceptance rests on analytical action constraints and safety/success tables, not generated visual fidelity.
Architecture, static G1 task setups, and high/low hallucination panels were available, but actual robot execution and continuous rollout quality could not be judged confidently.
failure_modes: No official project page, code, checkpoint, or execution video; physical study covers only two tasks.
visual_cards.undecided_reason: The embodied-demo gate requires an actual execution surface; static paper evidence is insufficient for a confident visual-quality decision.

visual_cards.visual_notes: Official galleries visibly demonstrate independent multi-agent control, shared-world consistency, four-agent transfer, and real multi-robot scenarios.
failure_modes: Generated-video worlds do not guarantee explicit physics or geometry.

issues: Actual robot and rollout demo quality cannot be inspected.
required_fixes: Human should inspect an official execution video or authors should publish a demo surface.
